questions.question: Please list the Italian text ruling of all the cards in the set Coldsnap.
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to fld075 = 'Italian'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld068 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T2.fld072 = T1.fld072 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T3 ON T3.fld081 = T2.fld063 WHERE T3.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld075 = 'Italian'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.text FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian'

questions.question: What's the Italian name of the set of cards with "Ancestor's Chosen" is in?
questions.evidence: Italian is a language which refers to fld075 = 'Italian'; with "Ancestor's Chosen" in the card set refers to fld049 = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
questions.SQL: SELECT fld094 FROM tab05 WHERE fld063 IN (SELECT fld063 FROM tab01 WHERE fld049 = 'Ancestor''s Chosen') AND fld075 = 'Italian'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT translation FROM set_translations WHERE setCode IN ( SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' ) AND language = 'Italian'

questions.question: What percentage of cards with format commander and legal status do not have a content warning?
questions.evidence: do not have a content warning refers to fld022 = 0; percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(fld022 = 0),COUNT(fld001))*100 where fld076 = 'commander' AND fld077 = 'legal';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.fld022 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE T2.fld076 = 'commander' AND T2.fld077 = 'Legal'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'commander' AND T2.status = 'Legal'

questions.question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
questions.evidence: mythic rarity printing refers to fld059 = 'mythic'; card banned refers to fld077 = 'Banned'; in gladiator format refers to fld076 = 'gladiator';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE T2.fld076 = 'gladiator' AND T2.fld077 = 'Banned' AND T1.fld059 = 'mythic'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'gladiator' AND T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'mythic'

questions.SQL: SELECT IIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld075 = 'Korean' AND NOT T2.fld094 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0, 'YES', 'NO') FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T2.fld063 = T1.fld063 WHERE T1.fld049 = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

questions.question: Which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec? List all of the cards name and its banned play format.
questions.evidence: ranked 1st on EDHRec refers to fld013 = 1; banned refers to fld077 = 'Banned'; play format refers to format; cards name refers to name

questions.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
questions.evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to fld077 = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(fld077 = 'Banned'))
questions.SQL: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT fld076, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM tab03 WHERE fld077 = 'Banned' GROUP BY fld076 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.fld076, T1.fld049 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T2.fld072 = T1.fld072 INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS MB ON MB.fld076 = T2.fld076 WHERE T2.fld077 = 'Banned'
questions.SQL_original: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'
